name: Specific gravity
title: Specific Gravity Calculator
desc: Use this specific gravity calculator to find the specific gravity of different materials and see whether they will float or sink.

c: Onim Example 1: Wood vs. Water — If the density of a wooden block is 0.65 g/cm3, what's its specific gravity, and will it float or sink in freshwater?
Onim Example 2: Homebrewed beer — If a homebrewed beer has a density of 1.05 g/cm3, what's its specific gravity, and is it heavier or lighter than water?
Specific gravity is greater than 1, so the substance will sink in cold freshwater.
Specific gravity is exactly 1, so the substance will be neutrally buoyant in cold freshwater.
Specific gravity is less than 1, so the substance will float in cold freshwater.

How the result is calculated: Take the density of the substance. Divide it by the density of water using the formula: specific gravity (sg) = substance density / water density Interpret the result: sg < 1 — Material will float; sg = 1 — Material is neutrally buoyant; and sg > 1 — Material will sink.

m.h: Linear regulators, known as buck regulators, convert high voltages to lower voltages. Main usage is for transforming AC to DC current.
Boost regulators step-up input voltages to desired higher output levels. Their primary usage is to transmit electricity via power lines over long distances.
